script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. BUS STOP - DAY

JESS (30s, determined, kind), dressed for work, sits on the bench, waiting for the bus. NERDY NEIGHBOR (40s, glasses, unkempt hair), sitting beside her, fiddles with his smartphone.

NERDY NEIGHBOR
(Mumbling to himself)
Why isn't this bus coming?

Jess notices the anxiety in his eyes and offers a comforting smile.

JESS
(Cheerful)
It'll come soon, don't worry.

A few moments pass, and a BUS rumbles up. Everyone stands up to board.

INT. BUS - DAY

Jess and Nerdy Neighbor take seats near the window. The BUS DRIVING squints in the mirror, assessing the passengers. The bus lurches forward, and they bounce in their seats.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jess and Nerdy Neighbor sit across from each other, sharing a table. He fumbles with a notebook and a pen.

NERDY NEIGHBOR
(Nervous)
I've been writing stories for years, but I've never had the courage to share them with anyone.

Jess smiles and leans forward.

JESS
Why not start with me?

He shares his stories, and she listens intently, offering encouragement and advice.

INT. LIBRARY - NIGHT

Jess and Nerdy Neighbor sit in a corner, surrounded by stacks of books. He reads aloud, and she offers suggestions and ideas.

INT. JESS'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jess sits at her laptop, writing. She receives a message from her EX-BOYFRIEND, MIKE (30s, handsome, self-centered).

MIKE
I've been thinking a lot about us, and I want to talk.

Jess hesitates, then responds.

JESS
(Determined)
I don't want to rehash the past. I've moved on.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jess and Nerdy Neighbor meet again, and he shares a new story about forgiveness. He dedicate it to her.

INT. JESS'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jess receives another message from Mike. This time, he apologizes for his past mistakes and asks for her forgiveness.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Jess and Nerdy Neighbor sit together, surrounded by the quiet of the library. She shares her own story of forgiveness. He listens intently, his eyes filled with tears.

INT. BUS STOP - DAY

Jess and Nerdy Neighbor wait for the bus together, smiling at each other.

JESS
(Grinning)
Maybe one day you'll have the courage to share your stories with the world.

NERDY NEIGHBOR
(Determined)
I will.

The bus arrives, and they board, waving goodbye to each other as they find their seats.

INT. BUS - DAY

As the bus moves along, Jess and Nerdy Neighbor look out the window, their minds filled with the power of forgiveness and the potential of new beginnings.

FADE OUT.
